'''Daz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He sold combat gear aboard [[Carrick Station]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Daz first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] planetary commendation vendor aboard Carrick Station. He was later relabeled as the Level 17 Equipment Vendor, though he was later removed along with the rest of the planetary Equipment Vendors in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]].
